messages.text: I'm in Germany. If I order a Bitaxe from you will it come with an EU plug? And what about customs?
Searched the catalog · Bitaxe desktop bitcoin miner

We don't have a product literally named "Bitaxe" — that's the open-source miner family, and we carry several: NerdQaxe++, NerdOctaxe, NerdQX, Harlo B30, Hammer Miner BC04. Each lets you pick an EU AC plug variant, and units ship from our US, UK, or EU warehouses — so a German order typically comes from the EU warehouse with the right plug already fitted. Since that's intra-EU shipping, you generally won't hit customs duties, though final taxes show at checkout. Which model were you looking at?
